description: This Java class is a JSON deserializer for provisioning criteria definitions within the Fineract project. It performs validation on JSON input data for creating and updating provisioning criteria, checking for required fields, supported parameters, and data consistency. It uses Gson for JSON parsing and is integrated with Spring Framework as a component.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A Spring Component that deserializes and validates JSON representations of provisioning criteria definitions for creation and updating operations in the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a provisioning criteria definition, checking for the presence of required fields, supported parameters, and logical consistency.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating an existing provisioning criteria definition, ensuring correctness and completeness of provided data.
